If your eyes always look tired, heavy, or “sleepy,” even when you feel rested, you’re not imagining it — your upper eyelids may be the reason. As we age, the delicate skin around the eyes begins to stretch, droop, and sag. For some people, genetics or natural facial structure can cause hooding at an even earlier age. This excess skin weighs down the upper eyelids, creating a fatigued or aged expression that doesn’t reflect how you actually feel.

At AestheticEye in Springboro, OH, we specialize in advanced eyelid procedures that rejuvenate the eye area with precision and artistry. One of the most effective solutions for tired, heavy-looking eyes is upper blepharoplasty, also known as an upper eyelid lift. This procedure removes excess skin and tightens the surrounding tissue, restoring a more alert, youthful, and energetic appearance.

Why Upper Eyelids Begin to Sag

A combination of natural changes contributes to “sleepy” eyes:

  • Skin Laxity: The skin around your eyes is the thinnest on your body. Over time, collagen and elastin decrease, causing the skin to lose its elasticity and sag.
  • Fat Redistribution: Aging can cause fat pockets near the upper eyelid to shift or protrude, contributing to a hooded or heavy look.
  • Muscle Weakening: The levator muscle, which lifts the eyelid, can weaken with age or overuse, contributing to drooping.
  • Genetics: Some individuals inherit naturally hooded eyelids or develop eyelid sagging earlier than others.
  • Environmental Factors: Sun exposure, smoking, allergies, and chronic eye rubbing can accelerate eyelid aging.

According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, eyelid surgery is one of the top five most popular cosmetic procedures, with thousands of patients choosing upper blepharoplasty each year to refresh and open their eyes.

How Upper Blepharoplasty Rejuvenates Sleepy Eyes

Upper blepharoplasty is a targeted surgical procedure that removes excess skin and may reposition or refine underlying fat. The result is a smoother, firmer eyelid contour that creates a brighter, more lifted appearance. Key benefits include:

  • A More Awake, Energetic Appearance: The upper eyelids play a huge role in facial expression. By reducing heaviness and hooding, the eyes look more open and alert.
  • A Younger-Looking Face: Sagging upper eyelids can add years to your appearance. An eyelid lift provides one of the most noticeable anti-aging improvements with minimal downtime.
  • Improved Symmetry: Upper blepharoplasty can correct uneven eyelids for a more balanced, harmonious look.
  • Better Vision in Some Cases: When excess upper eyelid skin hangs low enough, it can interfere with peripheral vision. Removing this skin can improve sightlines and daily comfort.
  • Natural, Long-Lasting Results: Results typically last 10–15 years, and the surgical incisions are hidden in the natural eyelid crease for a nearly invisible scar.

Who Is a Good Candidate for Upper Blepharoplasty?

You may benefit from this procedure if you notice:

  • Heavy or drooping upper eyelids
  • Hooded eyelids that hide your natural crease
  • Eyes that look tired or sad even when well-rested
  • Makeup smudging due to excess skin
  • Puffiness or loose skin along the upper eyelid

  • We use the latest surgical techniques

Your eyes are the focal point of your face — they deserve expert attention.

Refresh Your Expression and Restore Your Confidence

If sagging or hooded eyelids make you look tired, older, or less vibrant than you feel, upper blepharoplasty can make a dramatic difference. This simple, effective procedure opens your eyes, rejuvenates your entire face, and helps you look refreshed and confident every day.
